description: Read aggregated brand settings context for the selected workspace. Use this to inspect existing brand configuration before planning content or changing settings; it does not modify the brand.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_brand_settings_context
title: Get Brand Settings Context
